visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene opens with a close-up of a person's hands breaking a block of firm white tofu into irregular chunks over a yellow cutting board in a brightly lit kitchen. (2) A small metal bowl of salt is held, and salt is sprinkled over the tofu pieces; the person then places the tofu into a container lined with white cloth and covers it with a ceramic plate. (3) A raw salmon fillet is placed on a pink plate, and liquid is poured from a small white bowl onto it, followed by a generous sprinkling of salt from above. (4) A top-down shot shows white rice being washed in a sieve and then poured into a pink Le Creuset cast-iron pot filled with water and a few drops of oil. (5) Three raw eggs are cracked into a blue patterned ceramic bowl, and the hands use chopsticks to vigorously whisk them until combined. (6) In a small white bowl containing brown paste, dark soy sauce and a clear liquid are poured and stirred with a wooden spoon to create a sauce. (7) The salmon fillet is patted dry with a paper towel, sliced into cubes, coated in white starch, and placed into a frying pan with hot oil where it sizzles and turns golden brown. (8) The pressed tofu chunks are added to the pan after the salmon is removed, fried until lightly browned, and then pushed to the side to make room for the egg mixture. (9) Green leafy vegetables are added to the pan with the tofu and eggs, stirred together with a black spatula, and the fried salmon cubes are returned to the mixture. (10) The prepared sauce is poured over the ingredients, and everything is tossed together until evenly coated and steaming. (11) Bonito flakes are sprinkled over the finished dish in a white bowl, which is then held up to the camera. (12) A woman with short dark hair, wearing a white shirt and pink apron, eats the dish with chopsticks, reacting with wide eyes and a thumb-up gesture while sitting in a dining area.
